facts.fact: CABRI's case study says Kenya's IFMIS, an Oracle-based ERP run by an in-house National Treasury department, serves both national and county government, and that over 30 PFM ICT systems are operational across the Treasury and MDAs.
CABRI's case study says Kenya's IFMIS is run by an in-house IFMIS department of the National Treasury, in charge of implementing and managing the ERP.

CABRI's case study says the Government ICT Development Team built the Bajeti Yetu budget transparency tool for the National Treasury's budget department, and that Ministry of ICT and ICT Authority staff support PFM systems.
CABRI's case study says Bajeti Yetu was developed in December 2022 using in-house government ICT talent, avoiding commercial off-the-shelf software; no contractor is named.
CABRI's case study says IFMIS is implemented and managed by an in-house National Treasury department; no contractor is named for its operation.
